what: The exterior lighthouse's main entry door, measured in Godot on 19 Oct 2026 by ray scans against lighthouse_exterior_v3.glb as imported (scaled to 27 m, pivot at the base centre).
coordinate_frame: Same as lighthouse_greybox_v1_alignment.json: the exterior model's post-import local frame, metres. World = local + (5, 9.61, -8.5), no rotation (the Lighthouse node in Level.tscn).
porch_note: The door is set 1.2 m back in an arched porch on the house's north face, at its west end next to the tower; the porch floor is at the sill height.

greybox_v1_mismatch.entry_side: greybox_v1 puts its entry on the house's south face (entry_marker_local_u_v [0, -2.75] = local (-4.94, 1.06), facing (-0.707, -0.707)); that side of the exterior is a boulder plinth with windows and no door.
greybox_v1_mismatch.floor_height: greybox_v1 ground floor top is local y 3.6; the exterior door sill is local y 0.97, so the ground floor is 2.63 m above the door.
greybox_v1_mismatch.rotation: greybox_v1 walls run at 45 deg (long axis (0.707, -0.707)); the exterior's north wall at the door runs along (0.9024, -0.4309), about 20 deg off.
greybox_v1_mismatch.roof: greybox_v1 L1 walls (top local y 9.2) show above the exterior's roof from the south side.
